qrcodegen.use: Local QR encoding only. No transport/storage calls; no service or production build dependency.
qrcodegen.build: TypeScript 5.9.3: tsc qrcodegen.ts --target es2015 --lib es2015,dom --outFile qrcodegen.js --removeComments false
qrcodegen.normalization: End-of-line whitespace removed from upstream TypeScript and generated JavaScript; no licence wording or algorithm changes. Original digests retained.

wordlist.version: EFF large English list dated 2016-07-18; pinned by SHA-256
wordlist.license: CC-BY-4.0 under https://www.eff.org/copyright unless otherwise noted; no contrary notice found in this source
wordlist.attribution: Electronic Frontier Foundation; Joseph Bonneau. Dice codes removed in the generated JavaScript wrapper; word order/content unchanged.
wordlist.use: Local passphrase generation. No external wordlist fetch or telemetry.

jsqr.use: Independent test decoder only; never loaded by a utility page.

compiler.name: TypeScript
compiler.use: One-time development compilation outside the repository. Not a website or CI installation dependency.
